gloss: to sign a contract; to conclude an agreement

definitions.gloss: to sign a contract; to conclude an agreement
definitions.explanation: To formally enter into a contractual agreement with another party. A standard business expression.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}を{結|むす}んだ。
{新|あたら}しい{取引先|とりひきさき}と{契約|けいやく}を{結|むす}んだ。
examples.english: We concluded a contract with a new business partner.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}までに{賃貸|ちんたい}{契約|けいやく}を{結|むす}ぶ{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: I need to sign the rental contract by next month.

notes:
The verb {結|むす}ぶ literally means 'to tie' or 'to bind,' giving the image of binding parties together in agreement. This is the standard collocation for entering into contracts.

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {契約|けいやく}を{交|か}わす: to exchange contracts (similar meaning)
- {契約|けいやく}を{解除|かいじょ}する: to cancel/terminate a contract
- {契約|けいやく}を{更新|こうしん}する: to renew a contract
- {契約|けいやく}に{違反|いはん}する: to violate a contract

TYPES OF CONTRACTS:
- {賃貸|ちんたい}{契約|けいやく}: rental contract
- {雇用|こよう}{契約|けいやく}: employment contract
- {売買|ばいばい}{契約|けいやく}: sales contract

Also used more broadly for treaties and agreements: {条約|じょうやく}を{結|むす}ぶ (to conclude a treaty).
